38	// task-queue processes many tensors), so a single sort over the packed param
39	// buffer would cross tensor boundaries. The sort is therefore left as ONE
40	// explicit pre-kernel step (a batched torch.argsort per tensor in the Python
41	// driver — see INTEGRATION-NOTES.md) producing `perm`/`unsort` index buffers

57	//   needs `perm`/`unsort` populated before STAGE 0) with no other change.

59	// STAGE / BARRIER LAYOUT (per the decoder megakernel's discipline)

62	// ONE kernel. Because SG2 is PER-TENSOR (a tensor's attention couples only its

65	// only cross-CTA coupling is the task queue itself, and NO grid barrier is
66	// needed BETWEEN the meta stages (they are all within one CTA's tensor). The

79	//        f. attention (sg2_attention_score_and_accumulate over sel∪window)  →
80	//        g. out proj  csa_ctx = concat_heads @ out_W                         |
81	//   S2  HCA context (same shape; dense over all Nh + window, no indexer)     |
82	//   S3  matrix-GRU forward (z,r,h̃,h_new) per element, from

86	//        k×k Cartesian, softmax(×10) weights, per-element expert MLP, head
87	//        average) → expert_out_sorted[N]; *= rescale.                       |
88	//   S5  unsort expert_out to original order, then sg2_apply_step per element
89	//        (smart_grad = g + alpha·mu_new + lamb_eff·slow_new, then Adam tail).

100	// grid barrier between stages with cross-CTA dependencies (the sort and the

112	//   tensor's attention across the full grid, so this trades intra-tensor
113	//   parallelism for launch-elimination. That is a deliberate CORRECTNESS-FIRST

130	// result is deterministic (run-to-run identical) regardless of CTA scheduling.

144	//   * PEER top-k uses descending insertion sort; the reference uses torch::topk.

216	//      idx_DQ/idx_K 2*(8*4) = 64 ; hca q/k/v/out 4*64 = 256 ;
217	//      gru Wz/Wr/Wh 3*(4*26) + b 3*4 = 324  (xin = gru_in+gru_hidden = 22+4 = 26);
218	//      peer Wq 4*(8*22) = 704 ; prod A/B 2*4*(12*4) = 384 ;
219	//      experts W1/b1/W2 3*(144*16) + b2 144 = 7056.
220	//    35.3 KB < the 48 KB static smem cap (and below the decoder cell's ~42 KB),
221	//    so dynamicSMemBytes=0 and the occupancy>=1 guard hold. The expert codebook

224	//    this 35.3 KB is the SMEM-resident copy; with the per-thread scratch (topk

230	    const float* input_proj_W;
231	    const float* input_proj_b;

234	    const float* csa_k_W;
235	    const float* csa_v_W;
236	    const float* csa_out_W;
237	    const float* csa_compress_w;   // [csa_window]
238	    const float* csa_idx_DQ;       // [d_model, indexer_rank]
239	    const float* csa_idx_K;        // [d_model, indexer_rank]
240	    // HCA projections ([d_model,d_model])
241	    const float* hca_q_W;
242	    const float* hca_k_W;
243	    const float* hca_v_W;
244	    const float* hca_out_W;
245	    // matrix-GRU weights (nn.Linear .weight [out=gru_hidden, in=gru_in+gru_hidden])
246	    const float* gru_Wz;  const float* gru_bz;
247	    const float* gru_Wr;  const float* gru_br;
248	    const float* gru_Wh;  const float* gru_bh;
249	    // PEER routing: stacked per head
250	    const float* peer_query_Ws;    // [num_peer_heads, d_model, peer_in]
251	    const float* prod_keys_A;      // [num_peer_heads, pk_dim, d_model/2]
252	    const float* prod_keys_B;      // [num_peer_heads, pk_dim, d_model/2]
253	    // per-element expert MLP (shared codebook, indexed)
254	    const float* expert_W1;        // [num_experts, expert_hidden]
255	    const float* expert_b1;        // [num_experts, expert_hidden]
256	    const float* expert_W2;        // [num_experts, expert_hidden]
257	    const float* expert_b2;        // [num_experts]

261	//    parameter tensors back-to-back; tensor t occupies rows [row_off[t],
262	//    row_off[t]+n[t]). The per-CTA workspace is sized for the LARGEST tensor's
263	//    intermediates and re-used per tensor. The sort index buffers (perm/unsort)
264	//    are PRE-COMPUTED by the Python driver (the one explicit pre-kernel step).

268	    float* exp_avg_sq;     // [total]  Adam v
269	    float* mu;             // [total]  expert-output EMA  (sg2_apply_step mu_state)

271	    // Per-element matrix-GRU carried hidden state, ROW-major [total, gru_hidden].
272	    float* gru_state;      // [total * gru_hidden]
273	    // Pre-computed sort permutations, per tensor, ELEMENT-indexed into [0,n[t]).
274	    //   perm[row_off[t]+i]   = source row in ORIGINAL order for the i-th SORTED row

277	    const int* unsort;     // [total]

279	    //   layout per CTA (floats), Nmax = max tensor numel:
280	    //     x_sorted   : Nmax * d_model
281	    //     csa_ctx    : Nmax * d_model
282	    //     hca_ctx    : Nmax * d_model
283	    //     q/c_k/c_v/win_k/win_v (csa): 5 * Nmax * d_model  (reused for hca)

404	template <typename Dims>
405	struct SG2Work {
406	    float* x_sorted;   // [N, d_model]
407	    float* csa_ctx;    // [N, d_model]
408	    float* hca_ctx;    // [N, d_model]
409	    float* q;          // [N, d_model]  (scratch, reused csa/hca)
410	    float* c_k;        // [Ncmax, d_model]
411	    float* c_v;        // [Ncmax, d_model]
412	    float* win_k;      // [N, d_model]
413	    float* win_v;      // [N, d_model]
414	    float* qI;         // [N, indexer_rank]
415	    float* kI;         // [Ncmax, indexer_rank]
416	    int*   sel;        // [N, max(csa_topk,1)]  (int view)
417	    float* concat;     // [N, d_model]
418	    float* new_gru;    // [N, gru_hidden]
419	    float* expert_out; // [N]
420	    // ── STAGE -1 in-kernel segmented sort scratch (composed-megakernel path only;
421	    //    the standalone path pre-computes perm/unsort host-side into st.perm). ──
422	    float* sort_keys;  // [N] |grad| keys (bitonic, padded with +INF to Npow2≤2N)
423	    int*   sort_idx;   // [N] original-row indices carried through the sort

428	// Smallest power of two >= n (n>=1). Used to pad the bitonic sort length AND to
429	// size the sort scratch (declared before sg2_ws_stride, which reserves 2*Npow2).
430	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int sg2_next_pow2(int n) {
431	    int p = 1;
432	    while (p < n) p <<= 1;
433	    return p;
434	}

436	// floats-per-CTA stride. Conservatively sized for the LARGEST tensor (Nmax) so
437	// the same slice serves every tensor. Ncmax = ceil(Nmax/csa_compress) bounds the
438	// compressed buffers (csa stride 4 is the smallest, so it dominates over hca).
439	template <typename Dims>
440	__host__ __device__ inline int64_t sg2_ws_stride(int64_t Nmax) {
441	    const int64_t d = Dims::d_model;
442	    const int64_t rk = Dims::indexer_rank;
443	    const int64_t gh = Dims::gru_hidden;
444	    const int64_t Ncmax = (Nmax + Dims::csa_compress - 1) / Dims::csa_compress;
445	    const int64_t topk = (Dims::csa_topk > 1) ? Dims::csa_topk : 1;
446	    int64_t f = 0;
447	    f += Nmax * d;          // x_sorted
448	    f += Nmax * d;          // csa_ctx
449	    f += Nmax * d;          // hca_ctx
450	    f += Nmax * d;          // q
451	    f += Ncmax * d;         // c_k
452	    f += Ncmax * d;         // c_v
453	    f += Nmax * d;          // win_k
454	    f += Nmax * d;          // win_v
455	    f += Nmax * rk;         // qI
456	    f += Ncmax * rk;        // kI
457	    f += Nmax * topk;       // sel (int, 1 float each)
458	    f += Nmax * d;          // concat
459	    f += Nmax * gh;         // new_gru
460	    f += Nmax;              // expert_out
461	    // STAGE -1 segmented-sort scratch (composed path). The bitonic sort pads the
462	    // per-tensor N up to Npow2 = next_pow2(N), so keys AND idx each need Npow2 (not
463	    // N) slots. Reserve 2*Npow2(Nmax) for keys+idx — this bounds 2*Npow2(N) for ANY
464	    // N<=Nmax (Npow2 is monotonic), WITHOUT assuming Nmax is itself a power of two
465	    // (so a future model whose largest tensor is non-pow2 is still safe). perm/unsort
466	    // are exactly Nmax each (one int per element).
467	    f += 2 * (int64_t)sg2_next_pow2((int)Nmax);   // sort_keys[Npow2] + sort_idx[Npow2]
468	    f += 2 * Nmax;                                 // perm[Nmax] + unsort[Nmax]
469	    return f;
470	}

472	template <typename Dims>
473	__device__ __forceinline__ SG2Work<Dims> sg2_carve_ws(
474	    float* base, int64_t Nmax) {
475	    const int64_t d = Dims::d_model;
476	    const int64_t rk = Dims::indexer_rank;
477	    const int64_t gh = Dims::gru_hidden;
478	    const int64_t Ncmax = (Nmax + Dims::csa_compress - 1) / Dims::csa_compress;
479	    const int64_t topk = (Dims::csa_topk > 1) ? Dims::csa_topk : 1;
480	    SG2Work<Dims> ws;
481	    float* p = base;
482	    ws.x_sorted = p;   p += Nmax * d;
483	    ws.csa_ctx  = p;   p += Nmax * d;
484	    ws.hca_ctx  = p;   p += Nmax * d;
485	    ws.q        = p;   p += Nmax * d;
486	    ws.c_k      = p;   p += Ncmax * d;
487	    ws.c_v      = p;   p += Ncmax * d;
488	    ws.win_k    = p;   p += Nmax * d;
489	    ws.win_v    = p;   p += Nmax * d;
490	    ws.qI       = p;   p += Nmax * rk;
491	    ws.kI       = p;   p += Ncmax * rk;
492	    ws.sel      = reinterpret_cast<int*>(p);   p += Nmax * topk;
493	    ws.concat   = p;   p += Nmax * d;
494	    ws.new_gru  = p;   p += Nmax * gh;
495	    ws.expert_out = p; p += Nmax;
496	    // STAGE -1 sort scratch. The bitonic sort pads N up to Npow2 = next_pow2(N),
497	    // so keys/idx need Npow2 (NOT N) slots — carving them at N would overflow into
498	    // perm/unsort whenever N is not a power of two (e.g. N=384 → Npow2=512), which
499	    // SILENTLY corrupts perm (a non-permutation → missing scatter targets → zero
500	    // gru_state). Carve keys[Npow2] + idx[Npow2], then perm[N] + unsort[N]. The host
501	    // sizes the per-CTA slice at sg2_ws_stride(real_Nmax) which reserves 2*Npow2(Nmax)
502	    // (keys+idx) + 2*Nmax (perm+unsort); since this carves at Nmax_arg==N<=Nmax and
503	    // Npow2 is monotonic, 2*Npow2(N)+2*N <= 2*Npow2(Nmax)+2*Nmax fits — with NO
504	    // power-of-two assumption on Nmax (a future non-pow2-largest model is safe).
505	    const int64_t np2 = (int64_t)sg2_next_pow2((int)Nmax);
506	    ws.sort_keys = p;                              p += np2;
507	    ws.sort_idx  = reinterpret_cast<int*>(p);      p += np2;
508	    ws.perm      = reinterpret_cast<int*>(p);      p += Nmax;
509	    ws.unsort    = reinterpret_cast<int*>(p);      p += Nmax;
510	    return ws;
511	}

514	//  STAGE BODIES — each is CTA-cooperative with the owner-computes
515	//  determinism rule (one thread fully reduces each output element).
516	//  All transcribed from csa_hca_step_one's per-launch kernels; the math
517	//  building blocks are CALLED from sg::algorithms.
518	// =====================================================================

520	// S0: input projection (per element) + gather sorted features.
521	// x_out is computed per ORIGINAL element i: x_out[i,:] (sg2_input_proj_sort);
522	// then x_sorted[r,:] = x_out[perm[r], :]. We FUSE: each sorted-row r reads its
523	// source original row src=perm[r], projects that row's (g,s) directly into
524	// x_sorted[r,:]. This matches csa_hca_step_one (project all, gather by perm)
525	// bit-for-bit since the projection is per-row and the gather is a pure permute.
526	template <typename Dims, typename WeightsT, typename GradT>
527	__device__ __forceinline__ void sg2_stage_input_proj_sorted(
528	    const WeightsT& w,
529	    const GradT* __restrict__ grad,   // [N] original order (tensor slice)
530	    const float* __restrict__ sharp,  // [N] original order
531	    const int* __restrict__ perm,     // [N] sorted-row -> original-row
532	    float* __restrict__ x_sorted,     // [N, d_model] out (sorted order)
533	    int N) {
534	    constexpr int d = Dims::d_model;
535	    // CTA-local: this whole tensor is owned by ONE CTA, so the grid-stride is
536	    // blockDim.x (threads of this CTA), NOT gridDim*blockDim. One thread owns
537	    // one SORTED row r and computes all d channels (owner-computes → deterministic).
538	    for (int r = threadIdx.x; r < N; r += blockDim.x) {
539	        const int src = perm[r];
540	        float g = static_cast<float>(grad[src]);
541	        float s = sharp[src];
542	        if (!isfinite(g)) g = 0.0f;
543	        if (!isfinite(s)) s = 0.0f;
544	        #pragma unroll
545	        for (int dd = 0; dd < d; ++dd) {
546	            x_sorted[r * d + dd] =
547	                  w.input_proj_W[dd * 2]     * g
548	                + w.input_proj_W[dd * 2 + 1] * s
549	                + w.input_proj_b[dd];
550	        }
551	    }
552	}

554	// Generic per-(row,channel) projection out[t,d] = sum_k W[d,k]*x[t,k].
555	// Owner thread per output element does the full dot — deterministic.
556	template <typename Dims>
557	__device__ __forceinline__ void sg2_stage_project(
558	    const float* __restrict__ x,    // [N, d_model]
559	    const float* __restrict__ W,    // [d_model, d_model] row-major
560	    float* __restrict__ out,        // [N, d_model]
561	    int N) {
562	    constexpr int d = Dims::d_model;
563	    const int total = N * d;
564	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < total; idx += blockDim.x) {
565	        const int t = idx / d;
566	        const int oc = idx % d;
567	        float acc = 0.0f;
568	        #pragma unroll
569	        for (int k = 0; k < d; ++k)
570	            acc += W[oc * d + k] * x[t * d + k];
571	        out[idx] = acc;
572	    }
573	}

575	// CSA/HCA compressed K or V (weighted pool then project, fused per (j,channel)).
576	// Mirrors csa_compress_kv_kernel / hca_compress_kv_kernel. is_csa selects the
577	// pool helper + compress_w; hca uses mean (hca_w=nullptr) at stride hca_compress.
578	template <typename Dims, bool IsCsa>
579	__device__ __forceinline__ void sg2_stage_compress(
580	    const float* __restrict__ x_sorted,   // [N, d_model]
581	    const float* __restrict__ proj_W,      // [d_model, d_model]
582	    const float* __restrict__ compress_w,  // [csa_window] (csa) or unused (hca)
583	    float* __restrict__ c_out,             // [Nc, d_model]
584	    int N, int Nc) {
585	    constexpr int d = Dims::d_model;
586	    const int total = Nc * d;
587	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < total; idx += blockDim.x) {
588	        const int j = idx / d;
589	        const int oc = idx % d;
590	        float acc = 0.0f;
591	        #pragma unroll
592	        for (int k = 0; k < d; ++k) {
593	            float pooled;
594	            if (IsCsa) {
595	                pooled = sg2alg::sg2_csa_compress_kv<float>(
596	                    x_sorted, compress_w, j, k,
597	                    (int64_t)N, d, Dims::csa_compress, Dims::csa_window);
598	            } else {
599	                pooled = sg2alg::sg2_hca_compress_kv<float>(
600	                    x_sorted, /*hca_w=*/nullptr, j, k,
601	                    (int64_t)N, d, Dims::hca_compress);
602	            }
603	            acc += proj_W[oc * d + k] * pooled;
604	        }
605	        c_out[idx] = acc;
606	    }
607	}

610	template <typename Dims>
611	__device__ __forceinline__ void sg2_stage_indexer_q(
612	    const float* __restrict__ x_sorted,  // [N, d_model]
613	    const float* __restrict__ idx_DQ,    // [d_model, rank]
614	    float* __restrict__ qI,              // [N, rank]
615	    int N) {
616	    constexpr int d = Dims::d_model;
617	    constexpr int rk = Dims::indexer_rank;
618	    const int total = N * rk;
619	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < total; idx += blockDim.x) {
620	        const int t = idx / rk;
621	        const int r = idx % rk;
622	        float acc = 0.0f;
623	        #pragma unroll
624	        for (int m = 0; m < d; ++m)
625	            acc += x_sorted[t * d + m] * idx_DQ[m * rk + r];
626	        qI[idx] = acc;
627	    }

631	template <typename Dims>
632	__device__ __forceinline__ void sg2_stage_indexer_k(
633	    const float* __restrict__ x_sorted,  // [N, d_model]
634	    const float* __restrict__ idx_K,     // [d_model, rank]
635	    const float* __restrict__ compress_w,// [csa_window]
636	    float* __restrict__ kI,              // [Nc, rank]
637	    int N, int Nc) {
638	    constexpr int d = Dims::d_model;
639	    constexpr int rk = Dims::indexer_rank;
640	    const int total = Nc * rk;
641	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < total; idx += blockDim.x) {
642	        const int s = idx / rk;
643	        const int r = idx % rk;
644	        float acc = 0.0f;
645	        #pragma unroll
646	        for (int m = 0; m < d; ++m) {
647	            const float pooled = sg2alg::sg2_csa_compress_kv<float>(
648	                x_sorted, compress_w, s, m,
649	                (int64_t)N, d, Dims::csa_compress, Dims::csa_window);
650	            acc += pooled * idx_K[m * rk + r];
651	        }
652	        kI[idx] = acc;
653	    }

656	// CSA indexer top-k: per query t, score all Nc compressed entries, keep top-K by
657	// descending insertion (matches csa_indexer_topk_kernel exactly). Owner per query.
658	// Uses a small per-thread register array (CSA_TOPK<=64, the algo max bound).
659	template <typename Dims>
660	__device__ __forceinline__ void sg2_stage_topk(
661	    const float* __restrict__ qI,   // [N, rank]
662	    const float* __restrict__ kI,   // [Nc, rank]
663	    int* __restrict__ sel,          // [N, topk]
664	    int N, int Nc, int topk) {
665	    constexpr int rk = Dims::indexer_rank;
666	    const int K = (topk < Dims::csa_topk) ? topk : Dims::csa_topk;
667	    for (int t = threadIdx.x; t < N; t += blockDim.x) {
668	        float best_score[Dims::csa_topk];
669	        int   best_idx[Dims::csa_topk];
670	        #pragma unroll
671	        for (int i = 0; i < Dims::csa_topk; ++i) {
672	            best_score[i] = -INFINITY; best_idx[i] = -1;
673	        }
674	        const float* q = qI + t * rk;
675	        for (int s = 0; s < Nc; ++s) {
676	            const float sc = sg2alg::sg2_csa_index_score(q, kI + s * rk, rk);
677	            if (sc > best_score[K - 1]) {
678	                int p = K - 1;
679	                while (p > 0 && best_score[p - 1] < sc) {
680	                    best_score[p] = best_score[p - 1];
681	                    best_idx[p]   = best_idx[p - 1];
682	                    --p;
683	                }
684	                best_score[p] = sc;
685	                best_idx[p]   = s;
686	            }
687	        }
688	        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) sel[t * topk + i] = best_idx[i];
689	    }
690	}

817	        #pragma unroll

822	        // z, r gates: linear over xh (Wz/Wr are [gh, xin] row-major).
823	        float zg[gh], rg[gh];
824	        #pragma unroll
825	        for (int o = 0; o < gh; ++o) {

827	            #pragma unroll
828	            for (int k = 0; k < xin; ++k) {

843	        for (int k = 0; k < gh; ++k) xin_buf[gi + k] = rg[k] * h_old[k];

848	            #pragma unroll

851	            const float hn = (1.0f - zg[o]) * h_old[o] + zg[o] * ht;
852	            new_gru[r * gh + o] = hn;       // sorted order (feeds PEER)
853	            gru_state[src * gh + o] = hn;   // persist in ORIGINAL order
